# Ashlr MD

> Ashlr MD is an open-source Markdown desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with editing, export, local AI, and a bundled MCP server.

Version: 0.4.0. License: MIT. The desktop app is free; optional cloud AI providers may charge fees.
